Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch

Plan the display

Care and presentation

Coordinate colour and texture

5030225395549.sourceDescription:
Party Decorations
These party decorations add a decorative detail to the chosen display. Their red finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Colour: Red. Stated size: 3.8 Cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Self-adhesive backing allows for quick and secure attachment to compatible surfaces without the need for additional tools.
Water-resistant construction ensures durability and ease of maintenance, making it suitable for use in areas with occasional moisture.
Reusable design enables repeated use across multiple occasions when stored properly between displays.
Vibrant red finish adds a striking decorative detail that coordinates easily with surrounding settings.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 1 piece

These artificial cedar candle rings are designed to sit around candle bases for a festive look. Each mini wreath adds greenery and charm to taper candles, pillar candles or tea lights, and the round shape surrounds the candle without blocking the flame.

Each ring measures 3.54 in (9 cm) in inner diameter, a size that fits securely around most standard taper candles, pillar candles and votive holders. The ring slides easily onto the candle base and stays in place, so there is no tying or fixing to do, and the six rings in the pack can be spread across a table or saved for another setting.

The branches arrive folded and need to be opened out and shaped before use. The artificial material can be bent and adjusted into the look you want, holds its shape afterwards, and suits fireplaces, cabinets, office desks, garden tables and other spaces.

Made from simulated plant material that resists fading and tearing, the greenery looks realistic while staying clean and fresh. No watering, trimming or special care is needed, and the sturdy material can be used again over several Christmas seasons.

Place them on tabletops, mantelpieces, bookshelves, windowsills or in church settings. The mini size works in kitchens, living rooms, bedrooms and offices, and brings seasonal warmth to Christmas parties and family dinners.

Seven personalised snowman decorations in blue, which is a slightly unexpected choice for Christmas and rather nice for it — pale and frosted blues sit beautifully against dark green branches and white lights.

Each pendant is cut from wood, so it's shatterproof and light, with a matching ribbon loop already fitted for hanging. Adding names happens at the point of ordering, so one set can cover the whole family or every child in a class.

Wood wipes clean, doesn't fade the way printed card does, and won't crack in a cold loft over summer. They arrive ready to go on the tree, and being personal they tend to be the decorations that get looked for first every December.

Material: Wood
Seven personalised snowmen in frosted blue tones
Wood construction, shatterproof and light to hang
Ribbon loops already attached to each one
Wipes clean and won't fade like printed card
Personal ones are the decorations people look for first
Guarantee - 1 month

5096042276249.baseName: Christmas wreath with LED lights - Pine-style Christmas wreath - 50 warm white lights for a Christmas wall display - Green, 60 cm
5096042276249.variantName: Christmas wreath with LED lights - Pine-style Christmas wreath - 50 warm white lights for a Christmas wall display - Green, 60 cm
5096042276249.sourceDescription:
A 60 cm green pine-style wreath is paired with a separate 5 m string of 50 warm white lights. Its 16 cm depth gives the branches substance, and the separate string lets you decide how the light is distributed.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Fine pine-style sprigs lend themselves to a simple woodland scheme. A plain background keeps the outline of the needles visible, especially where the foliage spreads towards the edge of the decoration.

Warm white light works well alongside wood, brass and cream finishes. If you already have lighting in the same part of the room, see how the two colours look together at dusk before choosing the final position. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms.

View the arrangement in daylight first, then turn on the lights with the room lighting lowered. The two views can look quite different, and a small change in position often makes the points of light easier to see. Think about access to the controls before choosing the final position. Leave enough room to reach the switch comfortably while keeping the front of the arrangement clear, especially if you plan to change the lighting during the evening.

For a window display, test the position from both sides of the glass before making it permanent. Moving the decoration slightly away from a bright reflection can make the individual lights much clearer in the evening. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.
Includes a separate 5 m LED string with 50 warm white lights for flexible placement.
Features a substantial 16 cm depth to give the pine-style branches realistic substance.
Versatile design allows dual use as a decorative focal point in daylight or illuminated display at night.
Classic green pine-style foliage complements woodland themes and traditional holiday decor.
Comes with 5 m LED string with 50 warm white lights

5058194830649.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and white finish and wood, metal, and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Wood, Metal, and Plastic. Colour: Green and White. Stated size: 60 cm. Product weight: 0.9 kg. Quantity: 1 piece.
Timer function allows you to set and organise the operating period for convenient automated festive lighting.
Warm white illumination provides a soft, inviting colour tone that coordinates beautifully with other Christmas decorations.
Features realistic pine cone details and wood, metal, and plastic construction for a defined woodland-inspired appearance.
Compact 60 cm green and white design creates an ideal focal point for your door or indoor Christmas display.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Bring warmth and woodland charm to your festive décor with this 20cm Wooden Reindeer with Scene, a beautiful blend of natural craftsmanship and soft illumination. Expertly made from quality wood, this decorative reindeer features a finely detailed cut-out scene within its body, depicting a peaceful winter landscape complete with snow-dusted trees, a traditional cabin, and a glowing background that evokes the calm beauty of a snowy forest. The built-in warm white LEDs softly illuminate the scene from within, creating a gentle ambient light that enhances any Christmas setting. It also makes a thoughtful seasonal gift, blending craftsmanship, light, and warmth into one timeless decoration that can be enjoyed year after year.

Measuring 20cm tall, this Santa ornament fits perfectly on mantelpieces, windowsills, shelves, or tables, adding a magical focal point that enhances any festive display.
Battery-operated LED lights provide easy, cord-free flexibility, allowing you to place it anywhere in your home for a soft and inviting seasonal illumination.
A timeless piece that captures the spirit of Christmas, this wooden Santa makes a perfect gift or keepsake, adding warmth, charm, and festive cheer year after year.

5037204472949.sourceDescription:
Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: White. Stated size: 180 x 100 x 200 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Distinctive Father Christmas motif creates a recognisable festive focal point for your holiday display.
Durable fabric construction ensures a defined appearance and long-lasting seasonal decoration.
Generous 180 x 100 x 200 cm size makes a bold statement in any indoor or outdoor setting.
Easy to position and move, allowing flexible arrangement within your Christmas decor theme.
Guarantee - 1 month
Power source: Mains-powered
Suitable for: Indoor & outdoor use
Comes with 1 Unit

5059442204649.variantName: Noble Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 5ft (150cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 5ft
5059442204649.sourceDescription:
A pot-grown Noble Fir has a distinctive tiered shape, with well-spaced, sturdy branches that create a naturally full Christmas tree. Its dark green foliage features a subtle blue tinge, while the soft, flat needles give the tree a fuller appearance and make decorating comfortable and easy. The branches are strong enough to hold lights, baubles, and other decorations, while good needle retention helps the tree stay fresh throughout the festive period. A slightly spicy, festive fragrance completes the traditional real Christmas-tree experience without overpowering the room.
DECORATE WITH CONFIDENCE: The sturdy branches of this Noble Fir provide good support for lights, baubles, and other decorations, while the well-spaced tiers leave room to show them off. Its soft, flat foliage is also more comfortable to handle while decorating and won't scratch little hands.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
FRESH, FESTIVE LIVE POTTED CHRISTMAS TREES: Noble Fir has a slightly spicy fragrance that adds a distinctive festive note without being overpowering. Its good needle retention also helps it stay fresh throughout the Christmas period, so the tree continues to look and smell the part as the celebrations unfold.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR THE GARDEN: Once the festive season is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue to care for it as it grows. With their year-round colour, Noble Firs make excellent evergreen trees for garden structure.
VIBRANT POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE TO ENJOY YEAR AFTER YEAR: Bring the Noble Fir indoors again for future Christmases, returning it outdoors afterwards so it can continue to grow. With the right care, you can grow a Christmas tree that becomes a familiar part of your Christmas traditions year after year.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory

POT GROWN FOR LONG TERM USE - Grown in its pot from the start, this living Christmas tree can be replanted in your garden or kept outdoors in a suitable container after the holidays, offering a sustainable option that can be enjoyed for years to come.
TRADITIONAL CHRISTMAS APPEAL - With its naturally full shape and abundant green foliage, the Norway Spruce delivers the unmistakable look of a traditional real Christmas tree. With proper care and regular watering, it will stay looking fresh throughout the festive period.
PERFECT FOR FESTIVE DECORATING - Strong, well-spaced branches provide plenty of support for Christmas lights, baubles and other festive decorations. Whether displayed indoors for Christmas or outdoors on a doorstep or patio, it creates an eye-catching seasonal centrepiece.
AUTHENTIC FESTIVE FRAGRANCE - Norway Spruce is loved for its distinctive, fresh pine fragrance, filling your home with the natural scent traditionally associated with a real Christmas tree and adding to the festive atmosphere.
